literal: Indeed like humans resemble the base people; such a resemblance as them, we have seen not.
translation: The base resemble human beings; we have never seen another similarity so perfect as that.
modern: கீழ்மக்கள் மனிதர்களைப் போலவே இருக்கிறார்கள்; அவர்களைப் போன்ற ஒரு முழுமையான ஒற்றுமையை நாம் எங்கும் கண்டதில்லை.
explanation: This couplet highlights the deceptive appearance of ignoble or base people. Outwardly, they look exactly like normal human beings, showing no physical difference. The poet humorously remarks that he has never seen such a perfect resemblance between two entirely different entities as that between the base and true humans. This serves as a warning that outward appearance is completely unreliable when judging a person's character.
